title: Code and data for: Consequence-guided clarification: releasing minimum-compliance topology-optimized designs from incomplete specifications
description: Solver, experiment scripts, frozen literature frame, screening and adjudication records, stored optimization runs, policy replays and figure/table generators for the manuscript 'Consequence-guided clarification: releasing minimum-compliance topology-optimized designs from incomplete specifications' (Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering, submitted). Third-party paper texts are excluded; their arXiv identifiers are listed.
